title: Stable SMP
description: Stable SMP is a Semi-Vanilla & Semi-Hardcore survival server.
body:
**The Stable SMP is a Semi-Vanilla and Semi-Hardcore survival server, with a focus on mace PvP.**
## Only the most dedicated survival players make it to the top.

### Semi-Vanilla:
- There is `/rtp`, `/tpa`, and `/home`.
- **Reduced** diamonds, ancient debris, enchanted golden apples, heavy cores, ghast tears, crying obsidian, & ender pearls.
- Nerfed villagers: Librarians, Armorers, Toolsmiths.
- No ender pearl stasis chambers or tripwire dupers.

### Semi-Hardcore:
- Dying in any way will result in a **3-hour ban**.
- Ranked players have reduced ban times.

Cheating of any kind is **not allowed**. (Including X-Ray, Freecam, Autoclickers, Macros, etc.)
